anne: heads up 1: rack e2 on eu-west1 warm pool (pool-gpu-warm-7) is seeing nvlink error counters rising and hosted-gen p99 jumping 100ms -> 820ms.
niko: yikes. any tenant hotspots?
mike: dashboards show lots of short (<5s) batch tasks from tenant 'quantilo' starting at 09:22. KV cache miss for that slice up ~10x.
sara: grabbing pods now, looks like many parallel workers: ```bash
kubectl get pods -n tenant-quantilo -l app=batch -o wide
NAME                                READY   STATUS    NODE             IP           
batch-runner-7b9c8d-aaa1         1/1     Running   gpu-node-euw1-21 10.3.4.21
batch-runner-7b9c8d-aaa2         1/1     Running   gpu-node-euw1-22 10.3.4.22
batch-runner-7b9c8d-aaa3         1/1     Running   gpu-node-euw1-23 10.3.4.23
```
sara: and `dmesg` on gpu-node-euw1-22 shows repeated nvlink timeouts.
platform-bot: [ALERT] pool-gpu-warm-7 nvlink_errs > 50 in 5m 1: auto-throttle candidate triggered. https://grafana.redwood/pool/pool-gpu-warm-7
tian: quick mitigation idea: 1) drain/evict preemptible batch pods for tenant-quantilo older than 3m; 2) steer inbound hosted-gen traffic to eu-west3 for 15m; 3) apply egress shaping to that tenant's slice. should reduce cross-rack nvlink chatter.
mike: eviction (dry-run): ```bash
kubectl delete pod -n tenant-quantilo -l app=batch --field-selector=status.startTime<2024-05-10T09:19:00Z --grace-period=20 --dry-run=client
```
anne: doing eviction now and flipping route rule to prefer eu-west3 for route=hosted-gen.
sre-oncall: monitoring tail logs and nvlink counters. if errors continue after routing change we should consider live-migrating some cold replicas.
niko: cost note: cross-region routing to eu-west3 ups egress by ~15% for those requests. acceptable for short window to protect SLOs.
sara: eviction removed ~120 batch pods, nvlink errs dropping. p50/p99 latency trending down.
tian: follow-ups: - tian: draft RFC for a "soft-slice" isolation class for high-churn short batch jobs - mike: quota tightening proposal for preemptible batch per-tenant - anne: scheduler tweak to deprioritize warm pools when kvcache_miss_rate > 4%
mike: I'll stub the quota PR and run sim of eviction impact on throughput.
sre-oncall: will keep this thread updated for 30m and then close. :thumbsup:
